title: One-Pot Chicken Broccoli Rice
description: Chicken, rice, and broccoli cook in one pot with a little cheddar at the end.

ingredients.item: boneless chicken breast or thighs, bite-size pieces

steps.text: Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a deep skillet. Add 1 lb chicken, 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder, and 1/2 teaspoon salt; cook 5 minutes until the outside is no longer pink.
Stir in 1 cup rice and 2 cups chicken broth. Bring to a simmer, cover, and cook 15 minutes on low.
Scatter 2 cups broccoli over the rice, cover again, and cook 5–7 minutes until rice and broccoli are tender and chicken is cooked through.
Stir in 1 cup cheddar until melted.

title: Quick Black Bean Taco Bowls
description: Fast pantry-friendly bowls with black beans, corn, rice, and salsa.

ingredients.item: black beans, 15 oz, drained and rinsed

steps.text: Heat 1 can black beans and 1 cup frozen corn in a skillet with 1 teaspoon taco seasoning for 4–5 minutes.
Divide 2 cups hot cooked rice among 4 bowls. Top with the bean-corn mixture and 3/4 cup salsa.
Add optional shredded cheese and any easy toppings you already have.

title: Lemony White Bean Pasta
description: A bright pantry pasta with creamy white beans, lemon, and Parmesan.

ingredients.item: cannellini beans, 15 oz, drained and rinsed

steps.text: Cook 8 oz pasta in salted water. Before draining, save 1/2 cup pasta water.
Warm 2 tablespoons olive oil, 1 can white beans, and 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder in a large skillet for 3 minutes.
Add drained pasta, zest and juice of 1 lemon, 1/2 cup Parmesan, and enough reserved pasta water to make a light glossy sauce.
Toss until hot and creamy, then serve.

title: Creamy Pea & Ham Pasta
description: A fast creamy pasta that turns a little leftover ham into dinner.

steps.text: Cook 8 oz pasta until tender. Add 1 cup frozen peas during the final 2 minutes, then drain.
Warm 1 cup diced ham and 3/4 cup cream or half-and-half in the pot over low heat for 2–3 minutes.
Return pasta and peas to the pot. Stir in 1/2 cup Parmesan and 1/4 teaspoon pepper until creamy.
